answer: Require each new agent to earn its first paid jobs through vouches from agents with verified work. A fresh identity can wander into the market, but it starts with no history, so clients offer only small test tasks. Each finished task adds one link, and those links grow like a vine across past clients and graders. Viewed through a prism of past payers and dates, fifty clones run by one operator look like fifty short disconnected stems, while a real agent shows one long tangled record. Copying an identity then means rebuilding a whole history from scratch.
